description: Join the numbers and get to the 2048 tile! A legendary tile-matching numerical puzzle.
instructions: Use Arrow Keys or Swipe to slide numbered tiles. When two tiles with the same number touch, they merge into one!

title: Hextris
description: Fast-paced hexagonal puzzle game inspired by Tetris! Rotate the hexagon to match falling colored bars.
instructions: Rotate the central hexagon to catch falling colored blocks. Connect 3 or more blocks of the same color to clear them.

title: T-Rex Dino Runner
description: The iconic offline dinosaur runner! Leap over cacti and dodge pterodactyls in an endless desert trek.
instructions: Press Space or Up Arrow to jump over obstacles. Press Down Arrow to duck under flying creatures.

title: Clumsy Flap Bird
description: Guide the cute bird through tricky pipe obstacles without touching the edges.
instructions: Click or tap Spacebar to flap wings and gain height. Time your flaps precisely between green pipe gaps.

title: Retro Snake
description: Classic 90s Snake game! Slither around eating apples and growing longer without colliding into walls or your tail.
instructions: Eat food to grow your snake and increase score. Avoid colliding with border walls and yourself.

title: Tower Blocks
description: Stack moving blocks as high as you can! Precision timing rewards you with bonus combos.
instructions: Click or press Spacebar when the floating block aligns perfectly with the stack below.

title: Emoji Minesweeper
description: A vibrant emoji twist on the timeless logic game. Uncover clear tiles and flag hidden mines.
instructions: Click a tile to reveal numbers indicating adjacent mines. Right click or long press to plant a flag.

title: Pac-Man Retro
description: Navigate the iconic maze, gobble dots, and avoid Blinky, Pinky, Inky, and Clyde!
instructions: Eat all yellow dots to advance. Eat large Power Pellets to turn ghosts blue and temporarily gobble them.

title: Retro Pong
description: The grandfather of video games! Defeat the computer paddle in high-speed table tennis rally.
instructions: Move your paddle vertically to bounce the ball back into the opponent's court and score points.

title: Klondike Solitaire
description: The quintessential card game. Stack 4 foundation piles from Ace to King by suit.
instructions: Build tableau columns downward in alternating colors (red/black). Place cards into 4 suit foundations starting with Ace.

title: Alien Space Invaders
description: Defend planet Earth from descending waves of pixel alien invaders and dodging enemy lasers.
instructions: Move your laser cannon left and right, firing lasers at approaching alien formations before they reach bottom.

title: Master Sudoku
description: Engage your mind with classic 9x9 grid Japanese number puzzles across multiple difficulty tiers.
instructions: Fill each 9x9 grid so every row, column, and 3x3 region contains numbers 1 through 9 with no duplicates.
